scenario.title: Agent edits a space-owned composer chart's SQL; the user approves
scenario.prompt: Only count payments of at least 10 in the Emulator space payments chart.
expect: an approval card shows the new SQL before anything is saved
after Approve, editContent succeeds with versionUuids before != after
the chart stays owned by Emulator scenarios
the chip opens the chart with the new totals
readBack: composer_chart_versions: one more row, its SQL has amount >= 10
ai_sql_approval row approved for the call

patch.value: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM postgres.jaffle.payments WHERE amount >= 10 GROUP BY 1

reply.text: Done. The chart now counts payments of at least 10: [Emulator space payments](/projects/{{project}}/composer-charts/{{space_chart}}).
